annotations.title: Judge a vault decision before capital moves (paid)

description: Call this before an agent moves capital into or out of a vault, with the decision it is about to make: the vault, the amount, the MANDATE it must stay inside and the CLAIMS the decision rests on. It is judged against our stored due-diligence snapshot of that vault, deterministically and without a model, and comes back with a `verdict`: `supported`, `conditional`, `human_review_required`, `insufficient_evidence` (the snapshot is older than your mandate accepts, or a claim states as known what the snapshot records as unread), `not_approved` (a mandate limit is broken or a claim is contradicted) or `out_of_coverage` (we hold no snapshot, nothing charged). Every finding cites the snapshot field it rests on as `dd:<digest>#<json pointer>`, so it can be checked and cannot be invented, and `requiredNextSteps` says what would change the verdict. A claim the snapshot contradicts is told the DIRECTION of its error, never the true figure: the figures are in the due-diligence report. PAID: $2 a judgement over x402, or inside a plan that reads due diligence. FREE with `dryRun: true` (can it be judged, how old is our snapshot, what would be checked; no verdict) and FREE in full on the two public sample vaults, ethereum-sentora-rlusd-main-6dc58a and ethereum-1337-usdc-94643e. A `supported` verdict means the decision is consistent with our evidence and its own mandate. It is not advice and not a guarantee about the vault. Keep the `digest`: anybody can confirm at /v1/reports/{digest} that we issued that judgement unchanged.

action.description: What the decision does. Default allocate.

amountUsd.description: The amount the decision moves, in US dollars.

claims.description: What the decision assumes, at most 20, each `{ field, value }` where `field` is a JSON pointer into the due-diligence document, e.g. /capital/withdrawableUsd, /capital/totalUsd, /subject/chain or /dimensions/0/level.

dryRun.description: True for the free preview: whether we can judge it and what would be checked, without a verdict.

mandate.description: The limits the decision must stay inside. Each is optional and a limit left out is not checked: `maxPositionUsd`, `maxShareOfVault` (0..1 of the vault’s capital), `maxShareOfWithdrawable` (0..1 of what the vault declares withdrawable now), `allowedChains` (list), `maxDimensionLevel` (the worst of low, moderate, elevated, high, severe that any of the six risk dimensions may read), `humanApprovalAboveUsd`, `maxEvidenceAgeHours` (default 48).

pass.description: A decision pass from this vault’s due-diligence report (its X-ASPERN-Decision-Pass header): 24 hours of judgements on that vault without paying again.

rationale.description: Free text, carried with the decision and not read.

vault.description: The vault slug, or an address we can resolve to one. `list_vaults` or `find_vaults` find a slug.

name: evaluate_vault_decision

checks.description: Dry run only: the checks this decision would get.

digest.description: SHA-256 of this judgement, recorded so it can be verified at /v1/reports/{digest}.

findings.description: Each check that said something: `kind`, `weight` (hard, evidence, soft, none), `evidence` (dd:<digest>#<pointer>, or null where it concerns the packet alone) and `says`.

judgeable.description: Dry run only: whether we hold a snapshot to judge it against.

limitations.description: What this judgement does not cover. Always present.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

paidBy.description: free-sample, report-pass (a pass from this vault’s due-diligence report) or this-call. Absent on a dry run.

price.description: Dry run only: the price of a judgement and the vaults where it is free.

requiredNextSteps.description: What would have to change for a better verdict, one line per finding.

sample.description: True on the two free sample vaults, where findings quote values.

says.description: Dry run only: the answer in one sentence.

snapshot.description: The snapshot judged against: `digest`, `readAt` and `ageHours`. Null where we hold none.

vault.description: The vault slug the decision resolved to.

verdict.description: supported, conditional, human_review_required, insufficient_evidence, not_approved or out_of_coverage. Null on a dry run of a vault we can judge.

verify.description: The path that verifies the digest.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
